children.label: Formula (A \lor B) \land \neg(A \land B) is a tautology?

children.value: No, it is not a tautology! This is actually the XOR operation.

children.label: Formula \neg A \land \neg B \land A is a contradiction?

children.value: Yes, it is a contradiction! It requires A to be both true and false simultaneously.
